The '''''Starspin''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prowler [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. It responded to a distress call sent by [[Oss Wilum]], who had stumbled on a crippled Republic [[Courier/Legends|courier]]. When the ''Starspin'' arrived, it assisted the courier and ordered Willum to depart the area.
